subject: BYOK + session logging: retention granularity & key rotation impact
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYOK + session/audit logging questions (Helix POC)

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for yesterday's walkthrough. A couple of follow-ups from our security team as we scope the POC:

1) Retention granularity: they want to confirm whether audit logs can be kept at event-level for 90 days and aggregated summaries for 2 years. Is that configurable per-customer or only platform-wide?

2) BYOK key rotation: if we bring our key to Redwood Private (BYOK), what happens to existing encrypted artifacts when we rotate the wrapping key? Do you support key rotation without re-encrypting persisted logs, or is there a migration window? Our ops team is sensitive about re-encryption windows.

3) Session logs and SSO: Helix requires session-level SSO events (login, token refresh, logout) to be forwarded to our SIEM in near real-time. Can Redwood stream these events separately from the raw audit stream?

I've attached our short requirements doc. Can we get confirmation on the above by EOD Tuesday?

—Alice
Security Architect, Helix Health
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYOK + session/audit logging questions (Helix POC)

Thanks Alice — forwarding to infra and product for precise answers. High level: we do support per-tenant retention settings for audit exports (not yet for in-console retention UI), and we have a streaming audit pipeline that can emit both raw events and filtered event channels (e.g., SSO/session events). But I want Karthik and Marissa to confirm the BYOK rotation behavior and the practical constraints.

Karthik, Marissa — can you confirm:
- whether we can keep event-level logs for 90 days and aggregated summaries for 2 years per tenant (and what the current cost/perf implications are)?
- whether BYOK rotation requires re-wrapping persisted objects or if we support an envelope-rotation pattern that avoids full re-encrypt?
- options for exposing a dedicated SSO feed to Helix (Kafka/HTTP webhook options and expected latency)?

I'll coordinate a short call if we need to demo the pipeline.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 12:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + session/audit logging questions (Helix POC)

Quick notes from infra:

1) Retention: We can configure per-customer retention windows at export time for the HDFS/S3 export tier. Live query retention in the observability console is currently platform-wide (90 days by default) — per-tenant console retention is on roadmap Q3. For long-term 2yr summaries we typically run a daily rollup job that stores aggregated events into a compact schema; we can expose that to customers as a daily CSV or query endpoint.

2) BYOK rotation: Redwood currently uses envelope encryption. The master key (customer-provided) is used to wrap per-object keys. Rotation of the wrapping key (BYOK) can be performed with an envelope-rotation workflow that does not require re-encrypting the data itself; we only re-wrap the object keys. Caveat: the rotation tooling is available for Dedicated and Private deployments only. For Hosted tenants we manage rotation but cannot accept customer-managed keys today.

3) SSO events stream: We can publish a filtered feed (SSO events only) to a configured Kafka topic or HTTP endpoint. Expected end-to-end latency is ~2-5s in normal load; we support backpressure and delivery retries.

Action items:
- Marissa to validate cost delta for per-tenant 90d event-level vs platform default (estimate by tomorrow).
- Jonas to confirm if we have a customer-facing retention UI timeline (product roadmap).

Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + session/audit logging questions (Helix POC)

Thanks — quick cost sketch attached (proposed-retention-matrix.xlsx). TL;DR:
- Per-tenant event retention at 90d increases storage and egress cost by ~12–18% for a typical small-med customer; 2yr aggregated summaries are cheap (under 3%).
- If Helix wants both raw 90d + 2yr rollups, recommend storing raw events in our cold export tier and surface rollups from the analytics bucket.

On rotation: to be explicit for the Helix ask — envelope-rotation avoids full re-encrypt, but there is a brief metadata-only window during rotation where objects reference both old and new wrappers; we have tooling to orchestrate that without downtime but it does require a maintenance window for Private installs to audit and confirm key provenance.

I've added delivery options for SSO events: webhook (signed, idempotent), Kafka (SASL), or syslog over TLS (for older SIEMs).

I'll join the call with Helix if you schedule it; Grace, how long do they need to review?

—Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Trust & Safety
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + session/audit logging questions (Helix POC)

Alice — thanks for the patience; we attached our proposed retention matrix and a short note on BYOK rotation mechanics. Summary answers:

- Per-tenant event-level retention for 90 days: yes, we can do this for Private/Dedicated POCs now. For Hosted customers, we can provide exported raw events per-customer to their S3/Kafka for 90d retention; console retention granularity per-tenant is planned for Q3.
- 2-year aggregated summaries: supported via daily rollups — we can provide an access URL or periodic CSV export.
- BYOK rotation: envelope-rotation supported for Dedicated/Private; avoids re-encrypt, but requires a brief, auditable rotation window. We will provide a rotation playbook and assist on the maintenance window.
- SSO/session feed: we can stream SSO events as a separate, signed webhook or Kafka topic; expected latency 2–5s.

Next steps:
1) Helix to confirm preferred delivery method for SSO events (webhook / Kafka / syslog).
2) Helix to confirm whether they want us to host raw 90d events (export) vs host them in-console for the POC.
3) If BYOK rotation will be required during the POC, propose a 1-hour maintenance window on the chosen Private/Dedicated environment — we'll provide the rotation playbook.

Shall we do a 30-minute call tomorrow 1pm PT to finalize?

Best,
Grace
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + session/audit logging questions (Helix POC)

Grace — this is great, thank you. Helix prefers:
- Kafka (SASL) for SSO events; low-latency delivery is critical.
- We want Redwood to export raw 90d events to our S3 bucket for the POC (Helix will manage long-term retention).
- We will schedule rotation during the POC; please share the playbook and an estimate of the maintenance window timing.

1pm PT tomorrow works for the call — please send a calendar invite and an internal runbook.

—Alice
